messages:
toni: Quick design review: api keys list + bulk-revoke flows. Couple things caught my eye after trying the prototype.
ben: Shoot them over. I only skimmed the mock earlier.	rik: (typo, I'm rik) I saw a few :eyes:
toni: 1) We currently show a trash icon for bulk actions. That communicates deletion but not 'disable'. Since keys are soft-deleted for 30 days, can we change icon to a pause/disable glyph and label the action 'Disable keys'?
anya: +1 on the label. Users assume trash=gone forever. Also the confirmation modal heavy red is scary for bulk disable. Use a strong warning but not full danger color.
ben: Implementation note: backend returns `status: active | disabled | expired`. Frontend can map `disabled` to a neutral-warning badge.
toni: 2) Expires pill: add small pill next to each key: e.g. `Expires in 20d` or `No expiry` for rotating keys. Make it low-contrast background so it doesn't compete with name.
rik: Suggestion: show relative time for human readability but include a title attribute with exact ISO timestamp.
anya: Accessibility: pills need to be keyboard focusable and announce remaining days via aria-label, e.g., "Expires in 20 days". Screen reader should know it's not an action.
ben: 3) Bulk revoke UX: current flow shows a single modal with list of keys to revoke. If some keys are non-revokable (policy / org-managed), we should gray them out and show a reason inline instead of blocking the entire bulk action. Maybe allow partial success with a clear post-action report.
toni: Yes, don't block. Post-action toast should summarize: "5 keys disabled, 2 failed (org-managed)" with link to details.
rik: Toast timing: keep bulk action summary toast visible for 12s and make it dismissible. Also include a small "View details" link to open a side panel with per-key status.
anya: Copy nit: in the current empty state we say "No API keys yet." Could be more helpful. Try: "No API keys yet — create one to start calling the Redwood API. Need a temporary key? Choose 'Ephemeral' to avoid long-lived credentials." Add CTA buttons: "Create key" and secondary "Learn about key types".
ben: Good call. Also consider a small checklist in onboarding for new projects: create key, store secret securely, rotate every 90 days.
toni: Keyboard flows: after bulk action confirm, trap focus in the summary panel so keyboard users can inspect results without focus jumping to top nav. Escape should close panel and return focus to the bulk select checkbox.
rik: Edge case: rotating while a key is disabled. We should disable 'Rotate' action for keys with `status: disabled` and show tooltip "Enable to rotate".
anya: Visual contrast checks: the disabled badge color fails AA on some builds. Let's run tokens through the contrast tool and pick a variant.
uxbot: Note: design-issue#589 documents suggested tokens and contrast alternatives. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/589
toni: Action items: 1) change bulk icon + label to "Disable"; 2) add expires pill with aria-label/title; 3) allow partial success for bulk revoke and add post-action details panel; 4) update empty state microcopy and CTAs; 5) disable rotate when key.disabled and add tooltip; 6) run contrast pass for badge color. I'll write a short spec and attach annotated mocks.
ben: I'll pick up the frontend bits: partial bulk report + toasts + pill UI.
rik: I'll update the API docs to make status explicit and add expiry timestamp field.
anya: I'll run accessibility checks and draft the empty state copy variants for testing.
toni: Thanks all! :sparkles:
